custody: Each phase has fresh create-only spec/trace/summary/closure; exact same installed definition, model, PID and process identity. Both compare to the same original before-managed-up swap witness. Original baseline is never reset.
reason: Planned medium reasoning may consume a larger share of its declared completion budget. Separate bounded serialized validation phases allow quality-first completion without silently extending the reviewed1800-second monitor bound. Frozen before any medium inference.
timeout_scope: capacity--timeout120 is urllib socket inactivity/connect/read timeout, not overall streaming wallclock deadline; capacity passes no deadline_seconds. Model max_tokens bounds completion; each resource guard independently bounds phase walltime.
transition: After first chain stops, atomically close its guard; no new inference during guard transition. Verify current resource limits and unchanged process/config, start second guard and require ready before next inference. Manageddown after finalphase or guard abort.
